Name: Realistic Cellar Size
Author: Cylesburk
Description:
This mod changes the cellar to be more realistic in size compared to the fully upgraded farmhouse. Giving the feel of the cellar being the actual foundation of the Farmhouse. You will NOT need to temporarily relocate your casks. This mod installs seamlessly over your current casks layout

To install:
1. Make a backup of the file Cellar.xnb located in the steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps folder.
2. Make a backup of your save file
3. Replace Cellar.xnb in your steamapps folder with the .xnb file found in this zip
4. Start game, and enjoy.

Nothing is require to use this mod.

Feel free to endorse if you find this mod useful. Thanks.
